name: AiMaxChat
author: aimaxchat

sections.description:
AiMaxChat adds the public widget script from the configured CDN URL and initializes it with bot-specific parameters.

Important Notice:
This plugin integrates with the AiMaxChat third-party SaaS service to provide AI-powered chat widget functionality and process user interactions.
– Third-party Service Website: https://aimaxchat.ru
– Terms of Service: https://aimaxchat.ru/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://aimaxchat.ru/privacy

By enabling this widget, user chat interactions, queries, and form submissions (leads) will be transmitted to and processed on AiMaxChat servers in compliance with personal data protection regulations (including 152-FZ options). A personal account on https://aimaxchat.ru is required to obtain the configuration parameters.

Important Language Notice:
The AI assistant is specifically trained, optimized, and tailored for the Russian-speaking segment and websites operating in Russian. While it technically works on any site, the quality of AI responses, context understanding, and database processing for other languages will be significantly lower.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip in WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings -> AiMaxChat.
  4. Paste botId, publicToken, apiUrl, and widgetCdnUrl from the AiMaxChat dashboard.
  5. Enable the widget and save settings.
